property_summary: For any admissible keeper and any two executeBatchDeposit calls, if the second call succeeds then the first call must have set lastUnpauseTimestamp, so the reference enforces a 15-minute cooldown; the buggy version never advances lastUnpauseTimestamp and allows repeated success within the cooldown.
change_summary: Replace the timestamp assignment with a self-assignment so lastUnpauseTimestamp is never advanced, allowing repeated batch deposits within the cooldown.
